description: Evaluation set for eval/sample_docs/cs_notes.pdf. 'evidence' is a phrase from the source passage: a retrieved chunk counts as relevant if it contains it (case/whitespace-insensitive). 'answer_keywords' are lower-case terms a correct answer should mention. 'out_of_scope' questions should NOT retrieve document chunks.

in_scope.question: What is the time complexity of accessing an array element by index?
in_scope.evidence: Accessing an element by index takes O(1)

in_scope.question: Why is inserting into the middle of an array slow?
in_scope.evidence: must be shifted

in_scope.question: What does each node of a linked list contain?
in_scope.evidence: contains data and a pointer to the next node

in_scope.question: What are the common types of linked lists?
in_scope.evidence: singly linked list, doubly linked list

in_scope.question: How fast is insertion at the head of a linked list?
in_scope.evidence: Insertion and deletion at the head take O(1)

in_scope.question: What principle does a stack follow?
in_scope.evidence: follows the LIFO

in_scope.question: What are the main operations of a stack?
in_scope.evidence: push (insert an element)

in_scope.question: Where are stacks used?
in_scope.evidence: function call management

in_scope.question: What principle does a queue follow?
in_scope.evidence: follows the FIFO

in_scope.question: What are the main queue operations?
in_scope.evidence: enqueue (insert an element)

in_scope.question: What is the purpose of a circular queue?
in_scope.evidence: A circular queue reuses empty slots

in_scope.question: What is the key difference between a stack and a queue?
in_scope.evidence: order in which elements are removed

in_scope.question: How many pointers does a stack need compared to a queue?
in_scope.evidence: only needs one pointer (top)

in_scope.question: How many children can a binary tree node have?
in_scope.evidence: at most two children

in_scope.question: What property defines a binary search tree?
in_scope.evidence: left subtree of a node contains only values smaller

in_scope.question: What is the search time in a balanced binary search tree?
in_scope.evidence: take O(log n) time

in_scope.question: What happens to BST performance when the tree is unbalanced?
in_scope.evidence: degrade to O(n)

in_scope.question: What is the space complexity of an adjacency list?
in_scope.evidence: adjacency list, which uses O(V+E)

in_scope.question: Which data structure does BFS use?
in_scope.evidence: breadth-first search (bfs), which uses a queue

in_scope.question: Which structure does DFS use?
in_scope.evidence: depth-first search (dfs), which uses a stack or recursion

in_scope.question: What is the worst-case time complexity of bubble sort?
in_scope.evidence: O(n^2) time complexity in the worst case

in_scope.question: What is the time complexity of merge sort?
in_scope.evidence: O(n log n) time complexity in all cases

in_scope.question: When does quick sort hit its worst case?
in_scope.evidence: worst case O(n^2) when the pivot choices are poor

in_scope.question: Stack aur queue mein main difference kya hai?
in_scope.evidence: order in which elements are removed
